contract_inferred: No 00-contract.md. Inferred from the page: web, Persuade (a SaaS landing page for a team workspace, with sign-up and demo actions), English only (html lang en at every width), several markets (the hero strip names 'US, EU, UK & APAC regions' and the footer links a 'South Africa Payslip Generator'). No right-to-left language is named.
overall_reason: The cards and sections wrap and reserve space well, but the page pays 249 requests and a 3.5 s lab LCP for a landing page, and its own install prompt covers the hero actions on the first phone screen.

score.reason: T-HOSTILE-CONTENT and T-TRANSLATE pass on the card grid, but T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB fails on 209 script requests (ROB-018), T-WIDTHS fails on the install prompt over the hero at 375 (ROB-009), and T-NO-SCRIPT loses 30% of the text (the sweep's ROB-001 Floor).

findings.title: Nothing overlaps, is sliced or hides under chrome
findings.where: 'Install Consile' prompt (div.flex-1.min-w-0 > p 'Install Consile', button 'Maybe later'), hero, 375px
findings.evidence: At 375 the page's own install card sits at y 650 to 800 (dom-375: 'Install Consile' at y 670, 'Maybe later' at y 755), directly under the 'Start free' button. tiles/375-00.png shows it covering 'Explore the live demo' and the 'Book a demo' line on the first screen.
findings.before: An install prompt that opens over the hero on the first phone visit.
findings.after: Show the install prompt only after a second visit or a completed action, and dock it as a bottom bar that reserves its own height instead of covering the hero.
findings.why: A first-time phone visitor sees the secondary call to action hidden behind a prompt to install an app they have not tried yet.

findings.title: Weight fits the page's job
findings.evidence: The landing page makes 249 requests (budget fail), 209 of them script files totalling 481 KiB (budget warn), and loads 5 font files (warn). The lab LCP is 3,452 ms, in the warn band above 2,500 ms (sweep performance hit). The brand logo is a 6,250px PNG shown at 28px (sweep performance hit).
findings.before: The landing route loads the app's code split into 209 script chunks and an unresized logo.
findings.after: Ship the landing route as static HTML with one small script for the demo and marquee, preload the hero face, and serve the logo as the existing SVG or a 56px PNG.
findings.why: Each of 209 script requests costs a round trip on a phone line, and the first paint of the hero waits on them for a visitor who has not signed up yet.
findings.root: The app bundle shared with the landing route

findings.title: Content and navigation do not depend on script
findings.where: Whole page, scripts off, all widths
findings.evidence: With scripts off 5,064 characters stay visible against 7,272 in the baseline, a share of 0.696 (resilience.hidden_content.scripts_off). The sweep's hidden_content hit (ROB-001, Floor) records 1,830 characters (27%) invisible with JavaScript off. The page also logs three 'net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET' resource failures on load (console_errors 5).
findings.before: About a third of the landing text appears only after script runs.
findings.after: Render the remaining sections in the static HTML and use script only to animate them in, behind a no-script safety class (draft ROB-204).
findings.why: A visitor or crawler without script loses a third of the case the page makes.

strengths: The feature, problem and security cards stack one per row at 375 and let titles such as 'SCIM 2.0 Provisioning' and long descriptions wrap (tiles/375-07.png, tiles/375-08.png); the document width equals the viewport at every width.

The stylesheet carries overflow-wrap: anywhere and break-words rules, 43 min-width: 0 rules, 11 dvh or svh heights against 5 vh, and 16 aspect-ratio rules, so long strings, phone chrome and late images have room.
Six of nine @font-face rules use font-display: swap, and three declare metric overrides ('Figtree Fallback'), so the main face swaps in without moving the text.
78 of 93 images are lazy-loaded and the largest image is 138 KiB.
not_investigated: T-STRESS: no hostile content was injected; long names were judged from layout evidence.
A right-to-left render and translated strings were not captured.
The page load was not throttled and layout shift was not measured as a number (capture predates the CLS record).
T-FAILURE-PATH and T-SLOW-LINE: async found no primary actions; sign-up and the live demo were not opened. Six images were blocked by the capture and are not verified.
T-EXTREME-COUNTS: the product preview's counts ('18 tasks due', '92%') are labelled sample data.
The hero text and links hidden at 375 are the sweep's phone_parity hit (ROB-002); cited, not repeated.
Capture prep clicked 'Reject All' on the cookie banner at every width.
Widths between the captures, landscape, zoom at 200%, back navigation and deep links.
